sentence: This project develops a gene therapy that lets patients with a childhood brain disease make an enzyme that reaches the brain and other organs.
This project builds a culture model of brain cells to study how compounds made by gut microbes affect inflammation in the brain.
This project offers mouse models of human cancer and imaging services to test treatments and study how tumors respond.
This project studies how cells around the egg send RNA to growing eggs, and tries to use this to improve fertility.
This project develops a single score that combines several kinds of patient information to predict which breast cancers will be deadly.
This project gives researchers deep learning tools and computing power to analyze genomic data, images and DNA sequences.
This project studies how losing one enzyme causes prostate cancer to develop and grow, and which signals change in the cancer cells.
This project uses microscopy, imaging and computer models to find out how one type of nerve cell in the retina handles visual signals.
This project studies how the brain adapts to hearing loss in one ear and how this makes listening in noisy places harder.
This project studies how two medicines shrink blood vessel overgrowth in a childhood tumor, and how cholesterol handling is involved.
This project tests a bedside device that helps doctors adjust the dose of a blood pressure drug during surgery.
This project builds computer tools that use simulations and generative AI to analyze and interpret brain imaging data.
This project trains scientists and doctors to work on muscle diseases such as myotonic dystrophy.
This project collects and stores DNA, RNA and blood samples and data from people to study the genetics of dementia diseases.
This project studies how a type of blood cancer grows outside the bone marrow, looking at its gene changes and gene activity.
This project studies how a gene mutation causes DNA stress in cancer cells and how this helps the immune system fight tumors.
This project tries to find out what causes Sjögren's disease and looks at body chemistry and environmental exposures to find treatment targets.
This project studies how conversations with romantic partners affect people trying to stay away from alcohol early in recovery.
This project tries to find out whether removing harmful chemicals in blood stem cells can prevent DNA damage in an inherited blood disease.
This project builds computer models to predict why people respond differently to influenza vaccines, especially older people.
